title: Modi Government Pushes India as Global AI Data Center Hub Amid Community Pushback
detail: The Modi government is promoting India as a global hub for AI data centers, positioning the country as a key infrastructure provider for the AI age. However, local residents and communities are pushing back against the large-scale infrastructure projects, citing concerns over land use, energy consumption, and local impact.

media.caption: Modi government promotes India as AI data center hub as residents push back against infrastructure projects
